cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Test the Impossible Claim
cards.instruction: Get someone else to take the first practical step that could prove the bizarre claim true.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. This tap gives you whatever you ask for. Ask for tea while I hold a cup. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're not using my good china for that.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. I'll hold a saucepan. You ask.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll ask, but I'm not tasting anything.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Ask for a biscuit instead. If one comes out, we won't need your tongue as equipment.

mechanism: A directs a tap test and changes equipment and requested output to get B to make the first proving request.
confusable: Unlike assuming the magic already works, A needs B to perform a concrete test while A only supplies support.
comparison: A harmless kitchen output test differs from probing and loading an invisible bridge.
seedUse: D152-a china refusal, saucepan and no tasting; S02-a adapts test conditions to B boundaries.
